title: Harrier Studio hiring illustrators and comic art crew
content: HARRIER STUDIO IS HIRING! OPEN POSITIONS: Illustrator (Full Stage), Sketch Artist (Drafter), Line Artist, Colorist, Compositor, Storyboard Artist, Styling Artist, Typesetter. Send CV & Portfolio to harrierstdrecruitment@gmail.com (Subject: Nama – Posisi – CV & Portofolio). Open until positions filled.

author: attenboroughac
title: Paid mural painter needed for exhibition wall
content: Open Call: Painting a mural for an exhibition at Attenborough Arts Centre. Jemisha Maadhavji is looking for artist/s to paint a floral wallpaper mural on one 10m wall. Acrylic paints; follow floral reference images. Commission fee £750. Materials provided. Duration 3 days: 28–30 September 2026. Location: Attenborough Arts Centre, Leicester. Send short bio, why suitable, portfolio/examples or website/Instagram to jemishamaadhavji7@gmail.com and Cc mybc1@leicester.ac.uk by 21st September 2026.
